description: R11 Session R: the proposal review rule book. Each rule tests one thing, with its inputs (paths into the review evidence), threshold, policy clause, CBUAE CRM article, Delegation of Authority rank and severity. Verdicts: supported, contradicted, exception, unverifiable. Add a rule by adding a row.

categories.data: Data: books, account conduct, bureau, audited financials, project data
categories.consistency: Internal consistency: totals, ask vs recommendation vs conditions, the memo's own stress, dates, limits, sign-offs
categories.policy: Policy and regulation: each exception mapped to its clause, CBUAE CRM article and DoA level
categories.connected: Connected parties: related-party dues, common sponsors, nominee holdings, names classified elsewhere, staff conflicts

rules.title: Memo figures agree with the proposal record and the books
rules.tests: Each figure in the memo's obligor, financial and request tables equals the proposal record (financial spreading, LOS terms).
rules.finding: {label}: memo {memo} against {record} in the record ({source}).
rules.policy_ref: Credit Policy 3.2 Accuracy of credit applications

rules.title: Facility table and financial highlights agree with the LOS and the audited accounts
rules.tests: Each facility line (existing, proposed, pricing) equals the loan origination system; each financial highlight equals the spreading of the audited accounts.
rules.finding: {label}: memo {memo} against {record} ({source}).
rules.policy_ref: Credit Policy 3.2 Accuracy of credit applications

rules.title: Existing exposure agrees with the book
rules.tests: The memo's existing exposure equals the obligor's EAD in the corporate book at the as-of quarter.
rules.finding: Existing exposure in the memo SAR {memo_exp:,.2f}m against SAR {book_ead:,.2f}m in the book.
rules.evidence: Corporate book EAD SAR {book_ead:,.2f}m; memo SAR {memo_exp:,.2f}m.
sources: Corporate book (EAD at the as-of quarter)
rules.pass_text: Existing exposure SAR {memo_exp:,.2f}m agrees with the book.

rules.title: Internal rating agrees with the rating system
rules.tests: The memo's internal rating equals the obligor's current rating in the book.
rules.finding: Memo rating {memo_rating} against {book_rating} in the rating system.
sources: Rating system (book at the as-of quarter)
rules.pass_text: Rating {memo_rating} agrees with the rating system.

rules.title: Account conduct: no returned cheques
rules.tests: No cheques returned for insufficient funds in the last 12 months (deposits domain).
rules.finding: {rc} cheques returned in the last {months_seen} months of account conduct.
rules.pass_text: No returned cheques in {months_seen} months of account conduct.

condition.what: No further returned cheques (monthly conduct check)

rules.title: Bureau status clear
rules.tests: The SIMAH/bureau flag on record is not adverse.
rules.finding: Bureau flag on record: {flag}.

rules.title: Bureau: returned cheques in the group
rules.tests: No cheques returned for insufficient funds at the borrower or its affiliates (bureau).
rules.finding: {rc} cheques returned for insufficient funds at the Dubai affiliate ({period}).
rules.pass_text: No returned cheques in the group.

condition.what: No further affiliate cheque returns

rules.title: Client-reported bank lines reconcile with CBRBR
rules.tests: Other-bank limits reported by the client equal the CBRBR total.
rules.when: client is not None and cbrbr is not None
rules.finding: CBRBR shows AED {cbrbr:,.0f}m of other-bank limits against AED {client:,.0f}m reported by the client: a gap of AED {value:,.0f}m.

condition.what: Facility letters for the new other-bank facilities and a reconciliation with CBRBR

rules.title: Facility letters for new borrowing at other banks
rules.tests: Every new facility at another bank is supported by its facility letter.
rules.finding: AED {amt:,.0f}m of new facilities at {banks} other banks with {letters} facility letters on file.
rules.evidence: Facility letters on file: {letters} of {banks} banks.

rules.title: Projects on schedule
rules.tests: No unfinished project is more than the threshold months past its planned completion (project monitoring).

derive.late: [p for p in projects if p['completion_pct'] < 100 and days(p['planned_completion'], as_of) > 0]
derive.worst: ([p['name'] for p in late if months(p['planned_completion'], as_of) == max([months(q['planned_completion'], as_of) for q in late] + [0])] + ['none'])[0]

rules.expr: max([months(p['planned_completion'], as_of) for p in late] + [0])
rules.finding: {worst} is {value:.0f} months past its planned completion.
rules.pass_text: No project more than {threshold} months late.

condition.what: Extensions of time formalised on the late projects
condition.check: all(p['eot_status'] == 'approved' for p in projects if p['completion_pct'] < 100 and days(p['planned_completion'], as_of) > 0)

rules.title: Project collections current
rules.tests: Every running project has been paid within the threshold days, with no certified payments outstanding.

derive.stalled: [p for p in projects if days(p['last_payment'], as_of) > 90 and p['completion_pct'] < 100]
derive.name: ([p['name'] for p in stalled] + ['none'])[0]

rules.expr: max([days(p['last_payment'], as_of) for p in projects if p['completion_pct'] < 100] + [0])
rules.finding: {name}: no payment since {since} ({value:.0f} days); {pending_n} certified payments (AED {pending:,.1f}m) pending.
rules.evidence: Project monitoring: last payment {since}; AED {pending:,.1f}m certified, unpaid.

condition.what: Project 2 payment received (AED 23.0m certified)

lever.label: Funded lines tranched until the Project 2 collection or extension of time

rules.title: Projects past completion with work outstanding
rules.tests: No project is past its planned completion with less than 90% of the work done.

derive.open: [p for p in projects if days(p['planned_completion'], as_of) > 0 and p['completion_pct'] < 90]
derive.name: ([p['name'] for p in open] + ['none'])[0]

rules.finding: {name} is past its planned completion at {pct:.1f}% complete.
rules.pass_text: No project past completion with work outstanding.

rules.title: Extensions of time formalised
rules.tests: Every late or stalled project has an approved extension of time.

derive.open: [p['name'] for p in projects if p['completion_pct'] < 100 and p['eot_status'] != 'approved' and (days(p['planned_completion'], as_of) > 0 or days(p['last_payment'], as_of) > 90)]

rules.finding: Extension of time not formalised on {open}.
rules.evidence: EOT status from the project monitoring report.

rules.title: Backlog cover within sector appetite
rules.tests: Backlog / revenue at most the maximum backlog cover (Admin -> Deal Desk Parameters).
rules.finding: Backlog AED {backlog:,.0f}m is {value:.1f}x revenue (up {g:.0%} from AED {prior:,.1f}m) against a {threshold:.1f}x maximum.

rules.title: Backlog growth reconciles
rules.tests: Prior backlog x (1 + stated growth) equals the stated backlog.
rules.finding: AED {prior:,.1f}m x (1 + {growth:.0%}) does not give AED {backlog:,.0f}m.
rules.pass_text: Backlog growth reconciles: AED {prior:,.1f}m x (1 + {growth:.0%}) = AED {backlog:,.0f}m.

rules.title: Backlog concentration by employer
rules.tests: No single developer above the threshold share of the backlog.
rules.finding: Backlog concentrated: {top:.0%} from one developer, {two:.0%} from two.
rules.evidence: Backlog by employer from the memo and the project list.

lever.label: Cap the group at about AED 910m tied to Project 5

rules.title: Working capital held
rules.tests: Working capital at least the threshold share of the prior year.
rules.finding: Working capital fell from AED {prior:,.1f}m to AED {wc:,.1f}m ({d:.0%}).

lever.label: Advance payment AED 66.2m credited to the project account and recovered first

condition.what: Advance payment AED 66.2m credited to the project account and recovered first

rules.title: No non-core investment funded from working capital
rules.tests: Non-core investments at most the threshold share of EBITDA.
rules.finding: AED {inv:,.0f}m invested in non-core property ({value:.1f}x EBITDA) while working capital fell to AED {wc:,.1f}m.

rules.title: Retentions on completed projects
rules.tests: Retentions on projects completed more than the defects-liability period ago are due, not 'not due'.

derive.overdue: sum([r['amount'] for r in ret if months(str(r['year']) + '-12-31', as_of) > dlp])
derive.years: str(min([r['year'] for r in ret])) + '-' + str(max([r['year'] for r in ret]))

rules.finding: AED {overdue:,.1f}m of retentions on projects completed {years} are shown as 'not due'; the {dlp}-month defects-liability period has ended on all of them.
rules.evidence: Retention ledger by completion year; defects liability {dlp} months.

condition.what: Retentions reclassified with ageing

rules.title: Parent related-party dues
rules.tests: Related-party dues at most the threshold share of the parent's total assets.
rules.finding: Related-party dues at the parent are {share:.0%} of its total assets, while the parent deleverages.
rules.evidence: Parent accounts: related-party dues {share:.0%} of total assets.

condition.what: Parent deleveraging plan with a timetable; related-party dues reported quarterly

rules.title: Receivables from related parties
rules.tests: Amounts due from related parties at most the threshold share of current assets.
rules.finding: AED {rp:,.2f}m due from related parties, {value:.0%} of current assets, mostly {main}.

condition.what: Related-party receivable reduced by AED 20m

rules.title: Receivables ageing
rules.tests: Receivables older than one year at most the threshold share.
rules.finding: {aged:.1%} of receivables are more than a year old.

rules.title: Cash conversion cycle
rules.tests: Cash conversion cycle at most the threshold days for a trader.
rules.finding: Cash conversion cycle {ccc} days against {threshold} for a building-materials trader.

rules.title: Shareholder withdrawals
rules.tests: Withdrawals by shareholders at most the threshold share of EBITDA.
rules.finding: Shareholder withdrawals AED {w:,.2f}m, {value:.0%} of EBITDA, while receivables age.

rules.title: Ownership change re-assessed
rules.tests: An ownership change in the last 12 months is followed by refreshed KYC and a re-rating.
rules.finding: Ownership of the group changed {value:.0f} months ago; KYC and rating not refreshed.

rules.title: Auditor-change covenant
rules.tests: The auditor was changed only with the bank's consent (covenant).
rules.finding: Auditor changed without the bank's consent: the auditor-change covenant is breached.

condition.what: FY2026 audit by an auditor on the approved list

rules.title: Auditor on the approved list
rules.tests: The audited accounts are signed by a firm on the bank's approved auditor list.
rules.finding: {aud} is not on the bank's approved auditor list.

lever.label: No new funded limits until audit by an approved auditor

rules.title: Standalone financials of the borrower
rules.tests: The borrowing entity's own audited financials are provided, not only the group's.
rules.finding: No standalone financials of the UAE branch; only the group's consolidated accounts.
rules.evidence: Financials on file: group consolidated only.

rules.title: CRO review signed
rules.tests: The CRO review box is completed on a proposal at this approval level.
rules.finding: The CRO box is empty; the CRO review of a material credit decision is missing.

condition.what: CRO review recorded on the proposal

rules.title: Unqualified audit opinion
rules.tests: The audit opinion is unqualified.
rules.finding: Audit opinion qualified: {q} (AED {amt:,.1f}m).

rules.title: Existing limits add up to the stated total
rules.tests: The facility table's existing limits sum to the stated total.
rules.expr: abs(sum([f['existing'] for f in fac]) - stated)
rules.finding: Facility table AED {tot:,.1f}m against the stated AED {stated:,.1f}m.

rules.title: Proposed limits add up to the stated total
rules.tests: The facility table's proposed limits sum to the stated total.
rules.expr: abs(sum([f['proposed'] for f in fac]) - stated)
rules.finding: Facility table AED {tot:,.1f}m against the stated AED {stated:,.1f}m.

rules.title: The memo's own stress against the funded lines
rules.tests: The memo's stressed peak deficit is covered by the funded lines.
rules.finding: The memo's own stressed cash flow peaks at an AED {deficit:,.1f}m deficit in month {month}, against AED {lines:,.0f}m of funded lines: AED {value:,.1f}m uncovered.
rules.evidence: Memo stress case: peak deficit AED {deficit:,.1f}m; funded lines AED {lines:,.0f}m.
rules.pass_text: Stressed deficit covered by the funded lines.

condition.what: Funded usage below the stressed path

rules.title: Recommendation consistent with the memo's own findings
rules.tests: 'Approve all' is not recommended when the memo's own stress leaves a deficit uncovered.
rules.finding: The memo recommends 'approve all' although its own stress leaves AED {d:,.1f}m uncovered, with no conditions attached.
rules.evidence: Recommendation line against the stress line.

rules.title: DSCR after the deal meets the covenant
rules.tests: Post-deal DSCR from the engine is at least the memo's DSCR covenant.
rules.when: dscr is not None and cov is not None
rules.finding: Post-deal DSCR {dscr:.2f}x against a {cov:.2f}x covenant.

condition.what: DSCR at least {cov:.2f}x (tested on the annual accounts)

rules.title: Leverage after the deal meets the covenant
rules.tests: Post-deal debt / EBITDA from the engine is at most the memo's leverage covenant.
rules.when: lev is not None and cov is not None
rules.finding: Post-deal leverage {lev:.2f}x against a {cov:.2f}x covenant.

rules.title: Pricing clears the hurdle
rules.tests: Lifetime RAROC of the ask at least the hurdle (pricing below hurdle is a pricing exception).
rules.finding: RAROC {raroc:.1%} against a {hurdle:.1%} hurdle: a pricing exception.

lever.label: Price and structure to clear the hurdle (Deal Desk optimiser)

rules.title: Collateral valuations current
rules.tests: Every pledged collateral valuation is no older than the threshold months.
rules.expr: max([months(c['valuation_date'], as_of) for c in col if c.get('pledged_in_ask')] + [0])
rules.finding: Collateral valuation {value:.0f} months old.
rules.pass_text: Collateral valuations current ({value:.0f} months at most).

rules.title: Group exposure within the approved cap
rules.tests: Group exposure after the request within the current group cap.
rules.finding: Group exposure after the request AED {after:,.1f}m exceeds the AED {cap:,.0f}m cap; the request raises the cap to AED {new:,.0f}m.

lever.label: Cap the group at about AED 910m tied to Project 5

rules.title: Cash margin on contractor guarantees
rules.tests: Sub-investment-grade contractor guarantees carry at least the minimum cash margin.
rules.finding: No cash margin on the guarantee lines ({cm:.0f}% against a {threshold:.0f}% minimum for a {rating} contractor).
rules.policy_ref: Credit Policy 9.2 Cash margin on guarantees

lever.label: 10% cash margin on the new guarantee limit

rules.title: Guarantees dated and in the bank's format
rules.tests: Guarantees carry an expiry date and use the bank's standard wording.
rules.finding: Guarantees are open-ended and in the beneficiary's format.

rules.title: Security perfected before drawdown
rules.tests: The corporate guarantee is perfected before drawdown, not deferred.
rules.finding: Perfection of the corporate guarantee is deferred.

lever.label: Perfected parent guarantee with a fresh legal opinion

condition.what: Parent guarantee perfected

rules.title: Legal opinion current
rules.tests: The legal opinion on the security is no older than the threshold months.
rules.finding: Legal opinion dated {d}, {value:.0f} months old (maximum {threshold}).

condition.what: Fresh legal opinion on the parent guarantee

rules.title: Performance bond on time
rules.tests: The performance bond was submitted by its due date.
rules.finding: Performance bond submitted {value:.0f} months late ({sub}, due {due}).

rules.title: Financed assets registered to the borrower
rules.tests: Assets financed are registered to, and mortgaged by, the borrower.
rules.finding: The vehicles would be registered to {to}, not the borrower: the bank's mortgage would sit on a third party's assets.

lever.label: Decline the vehicle limit as structured

condition.what: Vehicles registered to and mortgaged by the borrower

rules.title: Routing undertaking met
rules.tests: Turnover routed through the bank at least the undertaking (x the limit).
rules.finding: Routing undertaking {req:.1f}x the limit met at {got:.2f}x ({value:.0%}).

condition.what: Monthly routing at least 1x the limit

rules.title: Routing undertaking not lowered while unmet
rules.tests: The proposal does not lower an undertaking the borrower has not met.
rules.when: req is not None and new is not None
rules.finding: The proposal lowers the routing undertaking from {req:.1f}x to {new:.1f}x while only {got:.2f}x is achieved.

lever.label: Keep routing at 2x with monthly tracking; the limit steps down below 1x

rules.title: Connected names classified elsewhere
rules.tests: No connected party is classified (Substandard, Doubtful, Loss) at another bank or in litigation.

derive.name: ([c['name'] for c in cls] + [''])[0]
derive.lit: sum([c.get('litigation_aed_mn') or 0 for c in cls])

rules.finding: {name} ({link}) is classified {grade} at another bank and in litigation over AED {lit:,.0f}m.

condition.what: Cross-default and economic-dependency question answered

rules.title: Holdings through nominees disclosed
rules.tests: No group holding is held through nominees without full beneficial-ownership disclosure.
rules.finding: The group holds {share:.0%} of {name} through nominees.

rules.title: Group entities at Loss (CBRBR)
rules.tests: No group entity is classified Loss in CBRBR.

derive.amts: join(' and ', ['AED ' + str(round(e['amount'])) + 'm' for e in loss])

rules.finding: CBRBR shows {value} group entities at Loss (about {amts}).

condition.what: Connected-obligor deterioration (monthly bureau check)

rules.title: Staff conflict of interest
rules.tests: No bank staff member has an interest in the borrower, its guarantors or security providers.
rules.finding: A bank staff member owns {share:.0%} of the {party}: refer to Compliance.
rules.policy_ref: Code of Conduct: conflicts of interest; referral to Compliance

lever.label: Conflict of interest referred to Compliance (Art 5.10)

condition.what: Conflict of interest referred to and cleared by Compliance

rules.title: Connected parties performing in the book
rules.tests: No connected party of an existing borrower is in Stage 3 or 90+ days past due in the book.

derive.bad: [c['name'] for c in con if c['stage_max'] >= 3 or c['dpd_max_4q'] >= 90]

rules.finding: Connected names in default in the book: {bad}.
rules.pass_text: {n} connected names performing in the book.
